notes.title: ⏳ Release Delay Announcement – Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44790310/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png
Hi everyone,

We’d like to inform you that the release of Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX has been slightly delayed to April 18 at 4PM PST.

We're adding the final touches and a few last-minute features to ensure the best and most polished experience possible for all of you.

We truly understand your excitement, and we apologize for this short delay. But we believe this extra time will allow us to deliver a much better game for you to enjoy.

🙏 Thank you for your patience and continued support!

With love,
The Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX Team

notes.title: Two coming soon games on October !!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 
We are excited to announce that our two new games will launch this October.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420830/Happy_Numbers/
Happy Numbers is a relaxing, mind-blending, minimalist puzzle game that offer over 70 hand-crafted levels to immerse your self into. 
The game also constain a lot of beautiful characters to unlock. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418160/Happy_Quest/
Happy Quest is casual match-3 game. 
You are a kind hunter. You quest is help the beautiful girls in the town. Let's make them happy. 


Add it in your wishlist to receive notifications when the games release.


Also, updated Hentai Asmodeus to version 1.3.0 with some minor things:
- Fixed cloud save error. 
- Improve moan voice.
- Added Brazilian - Portuguese localize language. 
Big thanks for Roberto 'Romegark' and Luis 'Di3sIrae' Scassiotti with community translation contributions. 

Cheer.

notes.title: Hentai Asmodeus v1.0.4 and trading cards now available !!!!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! 
We are so happy that you always come with us.
What's new in v1.0.4:
- Support 32 bit system.
- Fix stuck loading error due to the long game directory name.
- Add a warning popup if you overwrite the old save.
- Add combos, hits text.
- Battle replay button when losing.
- Some small bug.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35688547/ac9687121b43b6e98b4b08e1179c17a6237fa71d.png

And finally, we added trading as you wish. Please enjoy !
And don't forget to look forward and support our next game! Cheerrrr

notes.title: Update version 1.0.1 Claire bug fixes and others...
notes.content:
We are happy to announce, the game has been updated to version 1.0.1 !!!
New things:
- Fixed Claire health bar display error.
- Balance Claire.
- Added buttons to Epilogue after winning Agenda 4 times.
- Gallery bug fix.
- Improve Hscene, add progress slider and can go to the next step immediately.

Thank you all for reporting us!
Hope you enjoy the game!!!
